skill.name: Auto-start trace session initialization
skill.description: Conditionally initialize and start a trace session at client startup if auto_start_session is enabled. Registers atexit handlers once, creates trace context with configured trace_name and default_tags, and updates legacy global references for backward compatibility.
skill.skill_body:
Check if auto_start_session is enabled in config. If enabled and trace context is None or not recording, register an atexit handler (guarded by _atexit_registered flag to prevent duplicates), start a new trace with the configured trace_name (or 'default'), apply default_tags if present as a list, instantiate a Session object, and update legacy global references (_client_init_trace_context and _client_legacy_session_for_init_trace) for backward-compatible code paths.

## Objective

Initialize tracing infrastructure on client startup with auto-start capability and backward compatibility
## Applicable Signals

- config.auto_start_session == True
- _init_trace_context is None
- _init_trace_context.span.is_recording() == False

## Contraindications

- Manual trace control is required by caller
- Trace session already active and recording
- auto_start_session is False or disabled

## Workflow Steps

- Check global _atexit_registered flag
- If not registered, call atexit.register(_end_init_trace_atexit) and set _atexit_registered = True
- Check if config.auto_start_session is True
- Verify _init_trace_context is None or span.is_recording() is False
- Retrieve trace_name from config or use 'default'
- Convert config.default_tags to list if present, else pass None
- Call tracer.start_trace(trace_name, tags, is_init_trace=True)
- If trace context created successfully, instantiate Session(_init_trace_context)
- Update global _client_init_trace_context and _client_legacy_session_for_init_trace for backward compatibility

## Constraints

- atexit handler must be registered only once (check _atexit_registered flag)
- trace_name defaults to 'default' if not configured
- default_tags must be converted to list if present

## Cautions

- Ensure atexit handler is idempotent or guarded by flag to prevent duplicate registrations
- Legacy global references must be updated atomically with trace context creation
- If tracer.start_trace fails, trace context remains None and session is not created

## Output Contract

- Trace context is created and actively recording; atexit handler is registered exactly once; legacy session reference is updated and accessible via global references for backward-compatible code paths.
